approval_ref: The active user goal directs continued construction of an advanced-model Reference feature while retaining every existing analysis path.
notes: Add an official OpenAI Responses API provider as a new optional feature; do not remove or redirect existing Mock, DeepSeek, Gemini, custom Chat Completions, local-model, legacy analysis or Reference paths.
Use the fixed official API base, a user-entered exact model ID, write-only credential handling and explicit transfer/possible-charge confirmation; saving settings must not call a provider.
Use stateless Responses requests with store=false, bounded existing evidence and explicit selected-page images only; do not enable tools or provider-side conversation state.

Normalize typed output and usage into the existing validation and durable-call boundary. Refusal, incomplete or unexpected output must fail closed, settle when usage is trustworthy, retain no rejected text and never retry or downgrade automatically.
Freeze api_protocol in new evaluation profiles and mark only new Responses task identities so historical Chat Completions identities remain stable.
No live provider request, paid call, model-quality claim or fixed-question benchmark is authorized by this implementation task.

All 116 focused Python tests and 24 localization tests passed. The focused set includes exact /responses request-shape inspection, store=false, strict text.format, bounded input_image conversion, typed output and usage normalization, safe refusal settlement, no rejected-text persistence and no automatic retry.
The complete local suite passed all 1,509 collected Python tests. Specification sync reports 149 requirements and 21 schemas; the DEV-149 context pack and change-list validation passed.

The local service restarted without a model call and retained the saved DeepSeek V4 Flash text-only profile with structured_output_mode=json_object and api_protocol=chat_completions. The new service instance has zero active runs, zero active verification jobs and zero unresolved model calls.
Official OpenAI Responses, Structured Outputs and image-input documentation informed the transport shape; provider acceptance, pricing and answer quality remain intentionally untested.
title: Add official OpenAI Responses provider for Reference analysis
objective: Let an explicitly selected official OpenAI model use the stateless Responses API inside the existing bounded Reference and call-safety framework without deleting or changing the behavior of established providers and product paths.
